name: Spotify Album Wallpaper
author: emil
description: Shows currently playing Spotify album art as the desktop wallpaper. Works with both the official Spotify client and Omarchy Spotify. Restores the original wallpaper when playback stops.

barWidget.description: Album art wallpaper switcher with crop and track info settings.

schema.label: Enabled
schema.description: When off, album art wallpaper is disabled and the original wallpaper is restored.

schema.label: Crop mode
schema.description: Fullscreen fills the screen with center-cropped art. Centered 75% shows the art at 75% of the shortest screen dimension. Centered native shows art at its native resolution.

schema.label: Show track info
schema.description: Display artist, album, and track title on the wallpaper using theme colors.

schema.label: Reset on close
schema.description: Restore the original wallpaper when Spotify closes or playback stops.
